title: Betsy Ross — Sewing the First American Flag
memory_verse: "Whatever you do, work at it with all your heart, as working for the Lord." — Colossians 3:23 (NIV)
objective: Students will learn about Betsy Ross and how she used her talents to serve her country by sewing the first American flag.
content: Betsy Ross was a seamstress who lived in Philadelphia. A seamstress is someone who sews clothes and other things with a needle and thread.

The story tells us that George Washington asked Betsy Ross to sew the very first American flag. She worked hard and made a beautiful flag with red and white stripes and white stars on a blue background.
Betsy Ross used the talents God gave her to help her country. She showed us that everyone can serve, no matter what job they have.
The American flag reminds us of our freedom and our nation. Every time we see the flag, we can thank God for America.
activity: Color or paint an American flag. Count the stripes and talk about what the stars and stripes mean.
discussion: What talent did Betsy Ross use to help America?
What talents has God given you?
Why is the American flag important to us?
